findings.source_quote: καὶ ἐνδεδυμένοι ⸢τὸ⸣ πνεῦμα ⸢τὸ ἅγιον⸣ τούτων τῶν παρθένων
findings.english_quote: The house/clothing and virgins imagery is retained;
findings.issue: The note claims retention of house imagery, but the selected source contains clothing and virgins imagery, not house imagery. This introduces an unsupported description of this unit.
findings.suggested_revision: Replace this clause with “The clothing and virgins imagery is retained.” Any reference to house imagery elsewhere should be explicitly identified as contextual and supported by a locator. Review the revised note before acceptance.

findings.source_quote: καὶ πάντοτε σπλάγχνον ἔχοντες ἐπὶ πάντα ἄνθρωπον
findings.issue: The independently repeated πάντοτε, “always,” is omitted from the compassion clause. Earlier occurrences of “always” qualify other predicates and do not explicitly preserve this clause's emphasis.
findings.suggested_revision: Consider “They always had compassion for everyone,” subject to fresh review.

findings.source_quote: ἐπλήθυνεν αὐτοὺς ἐν τοῖς κόποις τῶν χειρῶν αὐτῶν
findings.issue: The simplification drops “of their hands,” replacing the source's concrete description of their labor with unrestricted “work.”
findings.suggested_revision: Consider “He made them prosper in the work of their hands,” subject to fresh review.

findings.source_quote: καὶ ἐνδεδυμένοι ⸢τὸ⸣ πνεῦμα ⸢τὸ ἅγιον⸣ τούτων τῶν παρθένων
findings.english_quote: The house/clothing and virgins imagery is retained;
findings.issue: The note claims retention of house imagery that is absent from the selected source. The simplified edition inherits this unsupported description independently of its otherwise faithful clothing clause.
findings.suggested_revision: Replace this clause with “The clothing and virgins imagery is retained.” Identify and substantiate any broader contextual reference separately; review the replacement before acceptance.

findings.source_quote: λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν τοῖς τοιούτοις οὖσιν ἐγὼ ὁ ἄγγελος τῆς μετανοίας· διαμείνατε τοιοῦτοι, καὶ οὐκ ἐξαλειφθήσεται τὸ σπέρμα ὑμῶν ἕως αἰῶνος.
findings.english_quote: Preserve repentance conditions, confession, mercy and healing, and the declared foolishness, childlikeness/gentleness and spirit/seed alternatives.
findings.issue: The unit-specific simplification metadata claims preservation of confession, mercy, healing, and a foolishness alternative, none of which occurs in this selected unit. The supplied report locates the foolishness alternative in S.9.xxii.4, not S.9.xxiv.
findings.suggested_revision: Replace the inherited metadata with an accurate account of this unit's simplification, addressing its exhortation to remain as described, offspring promise, and disclosed childlikeness/gentleness and spirit/seed alternatives. Review the replacement independently.

summary: Both editions require revision. The standard text covers the selected clauses, but its imagery note adds an unsupported description. The simplified edition additionally omits explicit wording and contains mis-scoped simplification metadata. Both preserve reader-facing “servants,” contextual “repentance,” speaker identity, and the strong offspring promises. The disclosed childlikeness and spirit working readings remain source-compatible; their alternatives and conjectural status agree with the supplied project report. This review does not authenticate unseen manuscripts or certify exhaustive collation. Proposed corrections require fresh review.
